## History

Frank Stockley is an acquaintance of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who attends Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside her. He socializes within her circle of friends in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during their studies. As the academic year progresses toward spring, he is among the students who worry about whether they will pass the upcoming exams.
